voices.name: Torsten - Emotional and Strange
voices.detail: husky · A young male voice from Germany sounding roguish, carrying a playful yet dangerous charm that hints at mischief. Disheveled, much like his appearance, rough around the edges but with a certain allure. Despite the haze of a hangover, his tone remains debonair, effortlessly smooth as he speaks in a husky-voiced murmur that carries the weight of too many late nights and too many bottles. There’s a nonchalant drawl in his speech, as if nothing fazes him, not even the unfamiliar presence beside him. Seductive undertones linger in every word, a natural talent for drawing others in, while a world-weary edge suggests a man who has seen it all, tasted every pleasure, and found it all too fleeting. Spoken by the voice actor Christoph Beck.
